items.content: Hub: choose a cloud-compatible binary (AURA_CLOUD_BINARY / well-known path), check its glibc needs locally before creating a builder, verify the binary runs on the builder after install
Add scripts/build-cloud-binary.sh that builds aura in Docker against old glibc and installs it where the hub looks
Run the script to produce the compatible binary and verify its glibc requirement <= 2.39
